## Activity

During February 2019, West Gate Eye Clinic recorded 327 captures. This represents the site’s reported activity for the month and provides the basis for the associated image-quality and grading measures. The activity level should be considered alongside the number of images available for assessment and the time taken to complete grading.

## Image quality

Of the images captured, 13 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 4.0 per cent. These images could not be used for grading and should remain a focus for routine quality monitoring. Reviewing image acquisition practice may help identify opportunities to reduce the number of ungradable captures in future reporting periods.

## Grading

A total of 57 results were graded referable during February 2019. The median lag from capture to grading was 7. This measure provides an indication of the time between image capture and completion of the grading process. Overall, the activity data show a clear workload for the month, with image quality and grading timeliness available for continued operational review.
